name: SM_Fountain_Stone_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: round stone fountain, 2.75 m across: basin wall of twelve stones with a coping, dark still water, a central pedestal carrying an upper bowl, 1.2 m tall
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The water is a still, opaque dark disc with ripples in the normal map and a little algae: no transparency, depth or flow, and the spray of the original (family fountain_spray_fx) is not here. Wall stones are scored joints in one ring, not separate blocks. Stone is one tinted rock scan with procedural moss and lichen; carving detail comes from displacement, not from modelled tool work.
